PathOfBuilding.Notes:
UPDATE NOTES
LEVELING PROCESS -From level 1 to 12 I leveled with Rolling Magma linked to Elemental Prolif/Combustion + Holy Flame Totem. -After Level 12 I went Storm Brand, with leveling gear it was decent but not the best - Rolling Magma is still likely better unless you hate it. -At Level 28 you can swap to Penance Brand with the same links, Swiftbrand is nice early for faster pops. Make sure to take Shaper of Flames from first lab so you can ignite with Penance. -Good leveling uniques are Honourhome, Ncyta's Latern, Berek's Grip, Berek's Respite, Replica Prismweave.
PYRE SUPPORT -Pyre support only works with sceptre equipped, once you acquire Obliteration / Grace of the Goddess this should be removed.
GLOBAL PROLIF ON GLOVES -Shaper of Flames makes all damage ignite, and this includes Obliteration explosions, with Ignite prolif on glove implicit you can spread those ignites as well. -This makes for juicy explosion chains. -Later on you can use Oriath's End, or explosion chest if you want to use Grace of the Goddess while mapping.
CINDERSWALLOW -This flask adds a ton of damage through malediction and also from increasing damage dealt on ignited enemies. -It's also a Silver flask so it gives onslaught.
POLARIC DEVASTATION -If you want a little extra damage, this in the left ring slot will grant "Covered in Ashes" this applies a 20% increase fire damage taken debuff.
HERALD BUFF EFFECT & LYCIA ASCENDANCY -Every intelligence travel node can be changed into 5% herald buff effect, this adds up to quite a bit of damage for this build. -Once you start getting these, look to drop Mastermind of Discord for Farewell to Flesh ascendancy. (they are very close, make sure to check your build to see if it's better or not, depends on your damage gained) -You can go for Forbidden Flesh & Flame to get it back if you want. (it's a lot of damage)
SUPREME OSTENTATION -This removes all attribute requirements and allows you to tattoo every single travel node, as well as easily run Grace of the Goddess.
MELDING + AEGIS + PURITY OF ICE -An extremely tanky set-up that doesn't require Mageblood. (though is much better with it) -Melding gives you maximum resistance equal to your highest max resist, in this case it's cold. -Aegis has 5% max cold resistance built in, and combined with Purity of Ice, it's not that difficult to reach 86+ max resist, which is a huge defensive boost. -This does require you to drop Tempest Shield or a Herald, unless you fit in more reservation.
AILMENTS -You can run Stormshroud combined with Avoid Shock boots. (50-60% from essence, and Avoid Ailment + Avoid Shock implicits to reach 100%) -This will make you immune to ailments even if you drop Tempest Shield.
